transform.normalization: Transform is defined for the footprint at top layer, position 0,0, angle 0. Do not bake the placed board component rotation/position into this local transform a second time.
transform.sizeZ_zero: Zero height has compatibility handling that automatically adapts height; explicit measured height is preferable when known.
transform.angles: General format states degrees, positive counter-clockwise: format/index.md:34.
transform.import_units: Explicit mm/cm/m/mil/inch accepted by create; enum literal values in references/enums/ESYS_Unit.md:28,67,80,93,106.
transform.distance_unit_resolution: Main agent's C1 native UI pilot and saved checkpoint establish mil for this installed runtime's 3D transform distances: a 1.0 x 0.5 x 0.5 mm 0402 model is serialized as 39.37,19.685,19.685,0,0,0,0,0,0. This resolves the earlier generic-format documentation ambiguity for this runtime. Imported file units remain a separate parameter.
transform.bottom_layer: The top-layer normalized convention implies placement-side handling belongs to the renderer; explicit bottom-side matrix/orientation behavior is not described in the inspected transform text and needs native validation.
